[[Reclaimed Metal Plate]]s are [[token]]s that can be salvaged from [[Reclaimed weapon]]s. They can be exchanged for [[Plated weapon]]s with the [[Whispers Keeper (Dragon's Stand)|Whispers Keeper]] in [[Dragon's Stand]].

== Acquisition ==
=== Sold by ===
{{Sold by}}

=== Salvaging ===
* Salvaged from [[Reclaimed weapons]].
** Rare salvage from {{rarity|Fine}} (1%) and {{rarity|Masterwork}} (3%) variants.
** 100% salvage from {{rarity|Rare}} variant.

=== Contained in ===
{{contained in}}

{{recipe list by discipline}}

== Currency for ==
{{Vendor query table|currency=Reclaimed Metal Plate}}

== Notes ==
* It takes 38 {{item icon|Reclaimed Metal Plate}} (in addition to the map currencies) to complete the [[Plated weapon]] Collection, 2 for each one-handed weapon, and 3 for each of the two-handed weapons.
* 30 {{item icon|Reclaimed Metal Plate}}s are required for the {{item icon|Gift of Dedication|Gifts of Dedication}} for each set of [[Perfected Envoy armor]]; a total of 90 for all three sets.
* Assuming you buy the {{item icon|Provisioner Token}}s solely with {{item icon|Reclaimed Metal Plate}}s, an additional 50 are needed per piece of [[Perfected Envoy armor]]; 300 per weight class, or 900 for all three sets.
